name: texture-upload-simple
description: Verify the KTX2/DDS standalone texture upload pipeline: fetch a solid-teal 4×4 KTX2 fixture from /test-fixtures/, decode it via decodeGpuTexture.ts, re-encode to WebP via normalizeTextureFile, persist as a user material via persistUserMaterial, apply to the living/dining floor, and screenshot the resulting swatch.
